title: SymbolicSystem takes ObjectJointUser: algebraic equations and reaction forces of the recorded joints
author: Claude-JG
description: SymbolicSystem with ObjectJointUser on rigid markers of user bodies and the ground: nAE, AlgebraicEquations from the recorded constraintUserFunction with the marker states, ReactionForces C_q^T lambda from the recorded jacobianUserFunction projected by the marker Jacobians as the connector forces; SolveGeneralizedAlpha against SolveDynamic. Maintainer 2026-10-28.
